data.name: D100
data.value: The server has received the request headers and the client should proceed to send the request body.

data.name: D101
data.value: The requester has asked the server to switch protocols and the server is acknowledging that it will do so.

data.name: D102
data.value: The server has received and is processing the request, but no response is available yet.

data.name: D200
data.value: Standard response for successful HTTP requests.

data.name: D201
data.value: The request has been fulfilled and resulted in a new resource being created.

data.name: D202
data.value: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing has not been completed.

data.name: D203
data.value: The server successfully processed the request, but is returning information that may be from another source.

data.name: D204
data.value: The server successfully processed the request, but is not returning any content.

data.name: D205
data.value: The server successfully processed the request, but is not returning any content. Unlike a 204 response, this response requires that the requester reset the document view.

data.name: D206
data.value: The server is delivering only part of the resource due to a range header sent by the client.

data.name: D207
data.value: The message body that follows is an XML message and can contain a number of separate response codes.

data.name: D208
data.value: The members of a DAV binding have already been enumerated in a previous reply to this request and are not being included again.

data.name: D300
data.value: Indicates multiple options for the resource that the client may follow.

data.name: D301
data.value: This and all future requests should be directed to the given URI.

data.name: D302
data.value: The HTTP/1.0 specification required the client to perform a temporary redirect.

data.name: D303
data.value: The response to the request can be found under another URI using a GET method.

data.name: D304
data.value: Indicates that the resource has not been modified since the version specified by the request headers If-Modified-Since or If-Match.

data.name: D305
data.value: The requested resource is only available through a proxy, whose address is provided in the response.

data.name: D307
data.value: The request should be repeated with another URI; however, future requests should still use the original URI.

data.name: D308
data.value: The request, and all future requests, should be repeated using another URI.

data.name: D400
data.value: The request cannot be fulfilled due to bad syntax.

data.name: D401
data.value: Authentication is required and has failed or has not yet been provided.

data.name: D403
data.value: The request was a valid request, but the server is refusing to respond to it.

data.name: D404
data.value: The requested resource could not be found but may be available again in the future.

data.name: D405
data.value: A request was made of a resource using a request method not supported by that resource.

data.name: D406
data.value: The requested resource is only capable of generating content not acceptable according to the Accept headers sent in the request.

data.name: D407
data.value: The client must first authenticate itself with the proxy.

data.name: D408
data.value: The server timed out waiting for the request.

data.name: D409
data.value: The request could not be processed because of conflict in the request, such as an edit conflict in the case of multiple updates.

data.name: D410
data.value: The resource requested is no longer available and will not be available again.

data.name: D411
data.value: The request did not specify the length of its content, which is required by the requested resource.

data.name: D412
data.value: The server does not meet one of the preconditions that the requester put on the request.

data.name: D413
data.value: The request is larger than the server is willing or able to process.

data.name: D414
data.value: The URI provided was too long for the server to process.

data.name: D415
data.value: The request entity has a media type which the server or resource does not support.

data.name: D416
data.value: The client has asked for a portion of the file, but the server cannot supply that portion.

data.name: D417
data.value: The server cannot meet the requirements of the Expect request-header field.

data.name: D418
data.value: This code was defined in 1998 as one of the traditional IETF April Fools' jokes in RFC 2324 and is not expected to be implemented by actual HTTP servers.

data.name: D420
data.value: Not part of the HTTP standard, but returned by some APIs when the client is being rate limited.

data.name: D422
data.value: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

data.name: D423
data.value: The resource that is being accessed is locked.

data.name: D424
data.value: The request failed due to failure of a previous request.

data.name: D426
data.value: The client should switch to a different protocol such as TLS/1.0.

data.name: D428
data.value: The origin server requires the request to be conditional.

data.name: D429
data.value: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.

data.name: D431
data.value: The server is unwilling to process the request because the header fields are too large.

data.name: D440
data.value: A Microsoft extension. Indicates that your session has expired.

data.name: D450
data.value: A Microsoft extension. Indicates Windows Parental Controls are blocking access to the given webpage.

data.name: D451
data.value: The server is denying access to the resource as a consequence of a legal demand.

data.name: D494
data.value: Nginx internal code similar to 431 but introduced earlier.

data.name: D500
data.value: A generic error message given when an unexpected condition was encountered and no more specific message is suitable.

data.name: D501
data.value: The server either does not recognize the request method, or it lacks the ability to fulfill the request.

data.name: D502
data.value: The server was acting as a gateway or proxy and received an invalid response from the upstream server.

data.name: D503
data.value: The server is currently unavailable because it is overloaded or down for maintenance.

data.name: D504
data.value: The server was acting as a gateway or proxy and did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.

data.name: D505
data.value: The server does not support the HTTP protocol version used in the request.

data.name: D506
data.value: Transparent content negotiation for the request results in a circular reference.

data.name: D507
data.value: The server is unable to store the representation needed to complete the request.

data.name: D508
data.value: The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request.

data.name: D511
data.value: The client needs to authenticate to gain network access. Intended for use by intercepting proxies used to control access to the network.
